messages:
jess-sales: Heads-up — Prospect Lantern wants an "output contract" + linting checklist for the POC. They said differences in tokenization and optional fields killed earlier migrations. Need a compact acceptance doc and a smoke plan by EOD.

sam-eng: Ack. I can draft a minimal contract and a small linter that flags missing top-level fields and tokenization deltas. We should include: required schema, allowed nullable fields, max length for `response_text`, and an estimate method for token counts.

tariq-ps: Important: Lantern will fail the POC if their JS SDK sees a changed shape for `actions[]`. They also want a stable field for deterministic reranking keys.

liz-sec: Security checklist: confirm no PII in `metadata.traces`, KMS for customer keys if requested, and SSO + SCIM for enterprise. Also they asked about our SOC2 scope and whether we can sign their NDA addendum.

jess-sales: Pricing note from Lantern: they bill per token on their current provider; they want a mapping table to estimate monthly spend after migration. Can we include conservative and optimistic scenarios?

sam-eng: Yes — I'll add two columns: (1) raw token-count delta measured on their sample prompts, (2) effective token-rate after batching and kv-cache. Mention quantization/throughput tradeoffs if they care.

qa-ops: We'll need an eval set from Lantern (20–50 prompts) to run smoke comparisons. Would prefer a mix of short/long sequences and a couple of conversations to validate KV-caching behavior.

jess-sales: @tariq-ps can you coordinate the eval set ask? Also we need a definite acceptance test that fails noisy-but-acceptable wording differences (i.e., semantics ok) vs structural diffs (shape/field missing) which are blockers.

tariq-ps: Will coordinate. Proposed acceptance criteria (short):
- Required fields present: `response_text` (string), `id` (string), `actions` (array, may be empty)
- No new top-level fields unless agreed
- Token-count delta <= 20% for median prompt in eval set (we can relax if latency improvement > 25%)
- Deterministic `rerank_key` when `rerank_seed` provided

sam-eng: Draft lint rule (will add as a tiny npm tool):
```json
{
  "required": ["response_text","id"],
  "optional": ["actions"],
  "maxResponseChars": 12000
}
```

sam-eng: And sample normalization snippet (JS):
```js
// normalize responses to contract
function normalize(resp){
  return {
    id: String(resp.id || ''),
    response_text: resp.output || resp.text || '',
    actions: Array.isArray(resp.actions) ? resp.actions : []
  }
}
```

liz-sec: Also add a note about logging retention and access controls for POC (30 days, RBAC-only). If they require longer, escalate to sales legal.

jess-sales: For the pricing table — can you push a quick calc using their sample? I'll attach in the deck.

sam-eng: On it. Will run their sample through both our hosted and a cost-sim with batching params: {batchSize: 16, kvCache: true}. Expect tokens ~10–18% different for the sample set but will confirm.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: presales/lint-tool v0.1 -> staging at 1743210300 :white_check_mark:

jess-sales: Great. Action items: @tariq-ps collect eval set by EOD, @sam-eng push lint + cost table, @liz-sec confirm NDA path. I'll draft the one-pager acceptance contract and share for sign-off. :thumbsup:
